segments.title: A window you just closed comes back with Back
segments.body: Two pages deep in a doc that, like most web apps, saves as it unloads. Close the window with ⇧⌘W and bring it straight back with ⇧⌘T. nightly.1 was still closing it for four seconds, so the reopened tab had no history and Back did nothing; now Back goes to the page before.

segments.title: A third pane keeps both stacked tabs
segments.body: A split of Trip plan stacked over The Daily Ledger. Add Lexicon as a pane below Trip plan: nightly.1 dropped The Daily Ledger out of the split; now all three share it.

segments.title: Opening a Peek as a tab leaves pinned tabs alone
segments.body: A pinned Trip group with The Daily Ledger pinned after it. A link opens in a Peek, then Open as Tab: nightly.1 moved The Daily Ledger above the group; now the pinned order stays put.
